scope: Public-entry access and deployment attacks; executed by the required security gate

cases.attack: Submit a mutation from another Origin
Omit or forge the session-bound CSRF token
Replay a logged-out or expired login
Reuse a login after account disable or password rotation
Use concurrent workers or restart to bypass quotas

cases.expected: Persistent lease limit rejects the fourth stream

cases.attack: Start production with dev authentication, HTTP or weak database credentials
Run destructive/offline operations against a pinned production project
Upload a PDF with excessive pages
